entities.summary: Chợ Lớn, usually anglicized as "Cholon" in English sources, is a quarter of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It lies on the west bank of the Saigon River, having Bình Tây Market as its central market. Chợ Lớn consists of the western half of District 5 as well as several adjoining neighborhoods in District 6 and District 11, the extended area of Chợ Lớn is included part of District 8, District 10 in older time and wards of An Lạc, Bình Trị Đông of Bình Tân district in modern time. The quarter has long been inhabited by Chinese people and is considered the largest Chinatown in the world by area.
